Subject: Re: Discovery Recap + next steps — rotating demo windows

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Thanks again for today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

1) What we learned
- Primary use case: near-real-time clinical summarization for urgent care; throughput ~150k tokens/day, peak concurrency 20–25 reqs/min.
- Data constraints: PHI in prompts but no long-term storage; need customer-managed KMS and VPC connectivity.
- KPIs: P95 latency <350ms for short responses, <800ms for long summaries; cost target ~$0.003/token.

2) Proposed tech-deep-dive/demo
- Objective: walk architecture options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), run 20-min throughput test, and discuss quantization/prefix-caching trade-offs.
- Suggested attendees: engineering lead (Sanjay), security/compliance (Elena), Redwood infra lead (Ben), solutions engineer (Tessa).

3) Scheduling ask — rotating windows to cover US/EU/APAC
- To make the session accessible to your global team, we suggest a 3-week rotating cadence: Week A: US-friendly window (08:00–11:00 PT), Week B: EU window (13:00–16:00 PT / 21:00–00:00 CET), Week C: APAC window (23:00–02:00 PT / 10:00–13:00 AEST). Each session ~60 minutes; we can compress to 45 if you prefer.
- Attached: a simple availability grid and discovery notes.

4) Next concrete steps
- Can you confirm which window you prefer for the first demo? We can start with a US window next week or prioritize APAC if that is critical.
- If you want an A/B test across timezones for the first run, we can split into two 30-min blocks.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/medialign-deepdive
Drive notes: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcDEF/view?usp=sharing

Thanks — happy to adapt.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
